capability.name: Find decision maker contact
capability.description: Find a relevant contact at a target company who matches the seniority and functional area needed for a deal. This helps identify the person most likely to influence or move the opportunity forward. Read-only: it does not create, modify, or delete anything in the application.

inputs.name: company_name_domain_or_industry
inputs.description: The company, website domain, or industry used to identify the target organization.

inputs.name: seniority
inputs.description: The level of seniority used to narrow contacts to the appropriate decision-making level.

inputs.name: function
inputs.description: The business function or department used to focus on contacts responsible for the relevant area.

outputs.name: contact
outputs.description: The contact identified as a relevant person for the target company and filters applied.
